```python
import random

# Generate G(80, 0.4) with seed=7
random.seed(7)
n = 80
p = 0.4
edges = []
adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if random.random() < p:
            edges.append((i, j))
            adj[i].append(j)
            adj[j].append(i)

# Calculate degrees
degrees = [(len(adj[i]), i) for i in range(n)]
degrees.sort(reverse=True)  # Highest degree first
```

Now I'll apply a greedy coloring algorithm:

```python
# Greedy coloring with highest degree first

    for neighbor in adj[vertex]:
        if coloring[neighbor] != -1:
            used_colors.add(coloring[neighbor])
    
    # Assign smallest available color
    color = 0
```
